_readme: Manually curated lookup of manufacturer-specific (0xFC00-0xFFFF) Zigbee
clusters/attributes, sourced from inspecting zha-device-handlers and
zigpy source directly (never guessed from a numeric ID alone — see the
PRD 'Unknown Capability Labeling and Device Photos'). Consumed by
rebuild-capability-index.yml's enrichment step, which annotates
data/**/*.json's capabilities cache with resolved_name/resolved_source
fields wherever a match is found here, and records everything else as
'unknown' in data/unknown-capabilities.json.
Matching rule (see rebuild-capability-index.yml's findClusterMapping):
an entry with both 'manufacturer' and 'model' set only ever matches
that exact device; an entry with 'manufacturer' but no 'model' matches
any device from that vendor; an entry with neither matches globally.
This exists because the SAME numeric cluster ID is routinely reused by
different vendors (and even by different product lines from the SAME
vendor) for completely unrelated purposes — confirmed firsthand: Sonoff
alone uses 0xFC11 for at least four different attribute sets across its
TRVZB, ZBMINIR2, MINI-ZB2GS and ZBM5 product families, and 0xFC0F means
one thing for OSRAM/LEDVANCE lighting and something entirely unrelated
for a Centralite IAS device. Applying a mapping outside the scope it
was actually sourced for would be worse than leaving it unresolved.
This file is currently maintained by hand as new devices are added to
the database — there is no automated job that refreshes it from
upstream yet (see the PRD's open questions). Treat every entry here as
traceable to a specific upstream source file, not inferred.

clusters.name: WorksWithAllHubs (WWAH)
clusters.note: The one manufacturer-specific ID treated as safe across vendors — semi-standardized hub-compatibility signaling, not vendor-private in practice.

clusters.name: IKEA manufacturer specific config
clusters.caution: 0xFC81 is reused by other vendors (e.g. Linkind, zhaquirks/linkind/motion.py) for an unrelated purpose — this mapping is intentionally scoped to this exact model, not IKEA generally.

clusters.name: OsramLight
clusters.caution: 0xFC0F is reused by Centralite (zhaquirks/centralite/ias.py, cl_3321S.py) for an unrelated purpose — do not apply this mapping outside OSRAM/LEDVANCE.

clusters.name: OsramLight
clusters.note: LEDVANCE devices commonly reuse OSRAM's own quirk implementation — LEDVANCE acquired OSRAM's lighting business and several product lines share firmware/cluster behavior.
